report_independent_references.detail: Chip and consumer validators compare report.body.independent_source_evidence only at the selected reference index. They do not assert the complete array equals the corresponding expected post-stage individual_proof.source_evidence array (old references preserved at all other indices, with only the authorized selected digest changed). A regression that corrupts a nonselected independent reference in a successor report is not isolated by the explicit DATA predicates.

Add one candidate report control that changes a nonselected independent reference while leaving the ledger entry and selected reference valid, and require rejection through that predicate.
